2607.17946.title: A Geometric Perspective on Stabilizing Value Conflict Resolution
2607.17946.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle to navigate value conflicts when trained with the compressed scalar rewards of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). To address this challenge, we investigate how chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can help improve performance in this domain. Geometrically, we show that CoT correlates with further smoothing the model's loss landscape in its sharpest direction, helping resolve the optimization instability of traditional scalar rewards. We also demonstrate via relevant downstream benchmarks that value conflict-focused CoT may generalize to different kinds of moral reasoning, demonstrating that this CoT has the potential to be an effective mechanism for better moral reasoning. To capitalize on this potential, we create a new value conflict-focused CoT design that further smooths the sharpest direction of the loss landscape and increases moral reasoning performance. This finding shows that explicitly modifying and improving the design of reasoning dynamics offers a promising avenue for improving model performance on user requests with complex value conflicts, advancing pluralistic alignment in LLMs.
2607.17946.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在使用人類反饋強化學習（RLHF）所壓縮的標量獎勵進行訓練時，常常難以處理價值衝突。為了解決這一挑戰，我們研究了思維鏈（CoT）推理如何幫助改善該領域的表現。從幾何上看，我們表明，CoT 與在模型的最陡方向進一步平滑損失景觀相關，幫助解決傳統標量獎勵的優化不穩定性。我們還通過相關的下游基準展示了以價值衝突為重點的 CoT 可能會泛化到不同類型的道德推理，顯示這種 CoT 有潛力成為更好道德推理的有效機制。為了充分利用這一潛力，我們創建了一種新的以價值衝突為重點的 CoT 設計，進一步平滑損失景觀的最陡方向並提高道德推理表現。這一發現表明，明確修改和改善推理動態的設計為提高模型在處理複雜價值衝突的用戶請求時的表現提供了一個有前景的途徑，推進了 LLMs 的多元對齊。
2607.17946.author: Saket Reddy et.al.
